Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Buy journey & MPA: legal-to-PO timeline and next steps

Jamie — thanks for the chat earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so all stakeholders have the timeline and owners. I attached the initial MPA draft and our pricing quote for reference.

TL;DR
- GreenLeaf prefers PO (confirmed on call) but evaluating marketplace option as a secondary path.
- Proposed high-level milestones: legal review (MPA) → security questionnaire → finance PO approval → PO issuance.
- Target: PO issued by mid-November if reviews stay on schedule.

Proposed MAP / next steps (owners + ETA)
1) Alex (Redwood): Send MPA v1 + pricing (attached) — DONE.
2) GreenLeaf legal (Monica): Internal redline and key terms comments — ETA: week of Nov 2 (please confirm exact day).
3) GreenLeaf security: Fill out standard security questionnaire; Redwood will provide answers + SOC2 snapshot — ETA: start Nov 3, finish by Nov 12.
4) Redwood commercial (Karthik & Lauren): Review any redlines as they arrive and propose counterterms; provide DocuSign if acceptable.
5) GreenLeaf finance: Confirm purchase instrument (PO vs card) and payment terms; issue PO to Redwood — target Nov 16–20.

Open items I asked about on the call:
- Marketplace: Jamie said procurement is open to marketplace but prefers PO on direct contract for now. Please confirm if marketplaces (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) are required later.
- Data residency / logging: Redwood provides region-specific routing and audit logs; security can request additional evidence.

Attachments: GreenLeaf_MPA_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-quote-2026-10-31.pdf

Looking to schedule a short sync with Monica + your security lead next week to walk the MPA and the security questionnaire. What times work for you?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Thanks for the context — here's a procurement readiness checklist and realistic ETA based on similar deals. I will own commercial coordination with GreenLeaf.

Procurement readiness checklist (GreenLeaf)
- Legal review (MPA) — Typical turnaround: 3–7 business days depending on redlines. If they push material indemnity/limitation changes add another week.
- Security questionnaire + evidence review — 5–10 business days; we'll provide SOC2 report and answers to their standard questionnaire. May require a short walkthrough.
- Finance approval & PO issuance — 3–7 business days after legal signs off; depends on accounts payable cadence.
- Marketplace onboarding (optional) — Additional 2–3 weeks if they want to purchase via AWS/GCP marketplace (catalog, terms mapping).

Suggested milestones (calendar dates, US/Pacific)
- 11/2: MPA review begins (Monica) — aim for initial comments by 11/6.
- 11/3–11/12: Security questionnaire completion and follow-ups.
- 11/9: Commercial/legal sync to triage redlines (30m).
- 11/13–11/16: Finance routing and PO approval window.
- Target PO issuance: 11/16–11/20.

Fast-track options to accelerate to PO:
- Agree to a limited set of concessions (e.g., keep liability caps as-is, work from Redwood's MSA) and add a short term amendment for any pending items.
- Accept a letter of intent + initial purchase (card) to start consumption while PO processes.

I'll prepare a short internal playbook for this account (redlines we can accept, fallback language, DocuSign envelope). I'll also prepare a one-pager you can share with Monica + security ahead of the sync.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/link/placeholder/GL-1187

-Karthik
Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
